passive.name: Damnation
passive.description: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

spells.name: Death Sentence
spells.description: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.
spells.tooltip:
Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for {{ tauntlength }} seconds. The scythe does {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration.

Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy.

If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by {{ hitbonuscooldown }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dark Passage
spells.description: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.
spells.tooltip:
Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh.

The lantern also grants {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Flay
spells.description: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between {{ pattackdamagemin }} and {{ pattackdamagemax }} magic damage.

Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by {{ activeslowpercentage }}% for {{ slowduration }} second and take {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Box
spells.description: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.
spells.tooltip: Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, <status>Slowing</status> champions by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and <status>Slow</status> for half duration.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Damnation
effects: Innate: Thresh's armor does not increase through growth (per level).

Innate: Enemy champions, large minions and large monsters that die near Thresh drop a Soul for 8 seconds. Epic monsters drop 2 Souls while lesser minions and monsters have a 33.3% chance to drop a Soul.
Thresh automatically collects Souls near him or a placed Dark Passage.
Soul: For each stack, Thresh gains 1 ability power and 1 bonus armor.

variants.name: Death Sentence
effects: Active: Thresh throws out his scythe in the target direction, becoming unable to move or attack while it is in flight.

While the target is stunned, Thresh tugs his hook towards him twice, once after a 0.1-second delay and again 0.6 seconds after that. With each tug, the target is pulled a short distance towards Thresh. After 0.5 seconds of hitting an enemy, or instantly after hitting a minion or monster, Thresh can recast the ability while the target is Shackled.
Recast - Deathly Leap: Thresh stops tugging his hook and dashes to the Shackled enemy, becoming able to attack again upon arrival. He can cast Dark Passage and Flay during the dash.

variants.name: Dark Passage
effects: Active: Thresh throws his lantern to the target location over 0.5 seconds, lasting for 6 seconds while he remains nearby and granting sight of its surroundings. If Thresh moves too far away from the lantern, it returns back to him immediately.
An ally cannot select the lantern while immobilized, grounded, or silenced. The lantern will not expire from Thresh moving too far away if he is dashing with Deathly Leap.

variants.name: The Box
effects: Enemies that break a wall cannot do so again for 1 second.
